BiblicalUsage: David prays about the errors he cannot see: who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults. The word is for sins hidden even from the sinner, the faults no one else notices and the one who committed them does not either.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the secret faults are the ones I most need cleansing from, for I can confess what I see while only God can cleanse what I cannot.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
